item.title: Silly Vehicles Add-On
item.creator: Asiago Bagels
item.description:
Make your world even more fun with these silly CARS, BOATS and PLANES! Drive around in big hot dog, or take in the view as you fly your fast pizza jet! If you want to get around your world in even more style, then this Add-On is perfect for you!

+ 20+ Vehicles!
+ Adds Cars, Boats, & Planes!
+ Special abilities!
+ Perfect addition to any world!

faqEntries.heading: How do I craft the Silly Vehicles?
faqEntries.content: You'll first need a Silly Vehicles Crafting Table. You can view the recipe in a regular crafting table, or use 2 steak and crafting table to craft it! Inside the Silly Vehicles Crafting Table, you can view all recipes for the vehicles!

faqEntries.heading: How do I pick up my vehicle after placing it down?
faqEntries.content: You'll need a Silly Tool to pick up any vehicles from this Add-On. View the Silly Tool recipe in the Silly Vehicles Crafting Table.

faqEntries.heading: I lost my guidebook, how can I get another one?
faqEntries.content: You can craft another in a regular crafting table or a Silly Vehicles Crafting Table using one steak and one book in any orientation!

item.howToTitle: How to get started with the Silly Vehicles Add-on!

howToEntries.content: Getting started with the Silly Vehicles Add-On is super simple! First, you’ll need to craft a Silly Vehicles Crafting Table using 2 Steak and a regular Crafting Table. You can also open a regular Crafting Table to view the recipe and craft it directly from there! Once that’s complete, open the Silly Vehicles Crafting Table to view all the recipes for cars, boats, and planes! Simply craft whichever vehicles you want, and don’t forget to craft the Silly Tool as well. You’ll need it whenever you want to break and pick up one of your vehicles!
